sections.Profile:
The Tramway pinball machine, produced by Williams Electronics in 1974, was an electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek with artwork by Christian Marche. While it was designed with transportation and travel themes, the machine never went into full production.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Travel, Transportation, Cities, Original Theme, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Steve Kordek
- Art: Christian Marche
